name: Systemic Sclerosis Sjogren Myositis Long Case

reference.source: Long Cases in Clinical Medicine (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Fibroblast collagen stiffens skin and gut with Raynaud ulcers, CREST calcinosis and renal crisis; Sjogren dries eyes mouth teeth with Ro-La, and myositis weakens girdles with heliotrope Gottron rashes, Jo-1 lungs and malignancy links.
additionalDifferentials: SLE versus vasculitis versus scleromyxoedema versus inclusion-body by malar ANCA paraprotein and rimmed vacuoles
Diffuse versus limited versus overlap by scl-70 centromere and polymerase
Myositis versus neuropathy versus Eaton-Lambert by CK EMG and antibodies
additionalInvestigations: Scl-70 centromere polymerase with Ro-La Jo-1 Mi-2
Schirmer sialography with lung and renal screens
